verdict.rationale: The evidence documents meeting summaries, action items, AskFred Q&A, and sharing transcripts with email recipients. None of it shows Fireflies drafting a follow-up email for the user to review and send. Sharing transcripts and generating summaries are adjacent features, not a drafted follow-up email, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
